question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Off-colour
solution:
The correct answer is "**Feeling slightly ill**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom off-colour is** ****'slightly unwell'**.
 
• People use off-colour in a sentence to convey that someone is not looking or feeling well. 
 
 
• **Example**: *Her face was looking a bit **off-colour**__ after suffering from jaundice last week.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• The meaning of the idiom off-colour is** ** **थोड़ा सा बीमार**.
